summary: Comprehensive plan to refine the PET SLAM monetisation strategy, define a concrete 8-week community acquisition sequence targeting named competitive gaming Discords and subreddits (Smogon VGC, TFT Competitive, Auto-Chess, r/CompetitiveGaming), and strictly separate the digital-only Week 8 MVP (single-player training + marketplace UI) from post-launch features (PvP, auctions, IRL mode).
